notes.title: Knight's End - The final game in the Skautfold series coming this Halloween.
notes.content:
The Finale has taken shape.

The last game in the Skautfold story-ark will be titled [b]Knight's End[/b], will feature Len the First Knight, and take place only days before the inevitable destruction of life on earth.

Gameplay will be a mix of exploration and a separate screen timeline based combat system, with active defensive and aggressive play using the final iteration of the Guard system.

Planned release date is [b]this Halloween, so October 31st.[/b]




If you wish to know more in detail read on.

[b]Story:[/b]
The finale will follow the First Knight Lennecia as she undertakes a personal journey to save Saragat from a rather unfortunate fate. To do this she will venture onto the now abandoned Waltham Industries factory site, and delve deep into its secrets, facing the worst possible adversary for such a mission, Waltham himself. 
The story takes place only days prior to the now broken Moon's pieces laying absolute and final destruction to all complex life on Earth, and just before the Human built Citadel is to take off from London with as many humans as it can carry for a possible escape.
The story wont revolve around some contrived way to save humanity from the pieces of the Moon, but rather her personal mission to save Saragat from a horrible fate that awaits him.

[b]Gameplay:[/b]
Exploration will be very similar to the original game Shrouded in Sanity, with easier navigation.
Expect a similar style an atmosphere as you delve into Waltham's deepest secrets on his factory grounds and below.
However Combat will take place on a different screen, akin to jrpgs where you are transported on contact with the enemy.
Combat uses a timeline based system where actions take time to execute and have different cooldowns, both for you and the enemy. At all times you can see exactly what the order is via the visible timeline, allowing for precise planning.
Unlike most turn based rpgs you CAN an should actively defend yourself, minimising downtime and rewarding good timing, using the correct defensive action, or taking a bigger risk attempting to parry.
Each of your attacks have a status effect tied to them, with 3 different types of qtes to increase damage and chance of applying the status tied to the weapon.
Good timing on defensive and offensive actions will reward you with Chain, a resource you can use to unleash one of three different finishers, all playing into the rock paper scissor style weakness system, where the old-school combat triangle comes into play.
The battlefield will be reactive in that all attacks will leave a mark, so by the end of some fights it will get quiet messy.

All in all combat may sound complex, but its far easier to understand in practice, and I worked hard to ensure its far more engaging than the old-school simple turn based combat systems of the past. Controls are fast simplified to ensure no slow and cumbersome menu browsing will occur.

Here is a sneakpeek at a test combat screen

notes.title: #Patch 32
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]

-Summon system overhaul:
Summoning is now viable. the system now works as follows. Upon using the proper weapon(the books) hitting the enemy will roll your Eld stat against 100, meaning your Eld literally translates to a % chance. After this the game checks your DEVOTION against 100, meaning 1000 donated is 1% chance, while 100.000 vitae donated equals 100% chance to summon if the Eldritch check passes. But after the summoning is complete your chance to summon is reduced by 1 donation's worth. Now the system is viable to play but requires constant feeding, in return however.... you get full screen wipes in most cases.

-Flight now provides a guard regen, half of your normal on ground regen, this is a massive change in terms of how flight and late game works.

-Teleport blade upgrade mechanic implemented. You can now find and collect Shift Blade upgrades, each providing one more teleportation before you need to touche the ground or a wall. This means you can chain them for as long as 10 times when you find them all. This makes the shift blade a LOT stronger once upgraded and will provide ludicrous amounts of mobility.

-Overall damage formula altered to reduce incoming damage slightly.

-New game plus incoming damage increase reduced significantly.

-Pet damage is roughly doubled.

-Sniper boss mines now have a warning cue and are delayed slightly.

-Veimar boss cone timings and warning cue is improved.

-Robot suiciders now have a better warning cue.

-Final boss AI is slowed down for a bit more breathing room.

notes.title: Usurper-OST out now.
notes.content:
[h1]Usurper OST[/h1]

Well it's been a long time coming, but the OST DLC for Usurper is finally here! That's [b]44 tracks[/b], coming in at 3 hours, 24 minutes, and 40 seconds of music (that includes 3 bonus original orchestral pieces) for only $2.99 USD! All songs have been modified from the game files, so that they don't loop (otherwise you'd get abrupt endings to every song), and are in a high quality MP3 format. 

[url=store.steampowered.com/app/849130]Usurper - Original Soundtrack[/url]

Since the soundtrack has been composed over a year and a half, I wanted to make sure the OST was ready and all songs were up to quality before releasing it. I've spent a long time redoing several tracks from scratch because I felt they could be better. The area music for the City of Higher Life, for example, was completely redone over about 40 hours in 4 days. So if you notice significant differences from the music currently in game, you'll know why! I will of course get Steve to update any music that I've altered into the main game in due course.

In the folder with all the music, there is also a README file containing important info, and also a 350x350px album art cover for you to use in your music library if you wish.

[h1]Accessing the OST[/h1]

To access the files once you buy the DLC, please navigate to the hard drive/directory that you installed Steam/Usurper on. You will then find the soundtrack in the following folder:
[b]Steam > steamapps > common > Usurper > OST[/b]

Do not hesistate to leave a comment here, or contact me (preferably on Discord - see link at the bottom of this post) if you have any problems!


Thank you very much for your continued support, and enjoy the OST!

notes.title: 1.0 Version Update - Out of Early Access!
notes.content:
Early Access is over! (Some thoughts on that after the patch notes.)

[h1]Added:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]New game plus[/b] - This includes increased difficulty and carry over of all character stats and weapons. This has no limit, so technically reaching max level is now possible. (To trigger, reach the credits and the option becomes available.)
[*] [b]2 new optional bosses[/b] - Killing one disables a certain type of enemy around the citadel for good.
[*] [b]10 new weapons[/b] - Including the Spells, buy them at the now open store.
[*] [b]Shops![/b] - All shops are now open.
[*] [b]Maps[/b] - 3 more map tiers to buy.
[*] [b]Summons[/b] (A certain weapon found early on will be required).
[*] [b]Summon donations system, and store.[/b]
[*] [b]Pets[/b] - 3 new pets.
[*] [b]New NPC[/b] - In the core room after a certain story point, with more lore.
[*] [b]1 more big area.[/b]
[*] [b]Lore[/b] - 30 more lore "stars" added.
[*] [b]20 more tubes, and Yth stones placed.[/b]
[*] [b]Further sanity system implementation.[/b]
[*] [b]Music[/b] - 2 new songs to fit the new areas. 
[/list]

[h1]Changed:[/h1]

[list]
[*]Guard regen rates drastically altered. Kneeling will now double regen rate for natural regen.
[*]All weapon placements changed for better progression, and rewarding returning to older areas.
[*]Some bosses AI slightly altered.
[*]All bosses HP levels altered for better balance. (Especially later bosses.)
[*]New game plus boss AI improved, HP levels rise appropriately.
[*]New game plus enemy scaling.
[*]New game plus traps and ambushes placed. (Enjoy.)
[*]Final scene missing effects added.
[*]Pug hit punishment implemented.
[/list]

[h1]Fixed:[/h1]

[list]
[*]Further boss AI abuse fixes.
[*]Mirror transitions in certain areas fixed.
[*]Further sequence breaking prevention.
[*]Fixed certain walls that could make the player get stuck after kneeling down.
[*]Incorrect pet spawns upon loading/respawn should be fixed now.
[*]Help screen completely redone.
[/list]

I most likely missed stuff in the notes.

[h1]THOUGHTS, AND THANKS[/h1]

With this, the game is content complete and we exit Early Access.
[b]HOWEVER[/b], this does not mean support and additional content will stop. Just like with [i]Shrouded in Sanity[/i], you can expect further modes, bosses, pets, music, and even areas added to the game, as well as the obvious continued bug fixing and support.

I would like to especially thank everyone who bought the Early Access version of the game and trusted me to finish [i]Usurper[/i], I hope I can deliver a fun game worthy of the purchase and trust.

I'd also like to thank everyone on our Discord server who helped directly or indirectly. (The link to which is at the bottom of this announcement.)

Special thanks to [i]Ravness[/i] for being an incredibly helpful source of detailed bug reports.


[h1]JOIN OUR DISCORD[/h1]

[url=https://discord.gg/REKcMkf]Join our Discord server![/url]

As always, we strongly recommend that you join our Discord server if you want to be completely up-to-date, or just want to hang out. We are extremely active on there, posting updates and screenshots most days. And if you're worried about spoilers, we have dedicated rooms for those, so they're easy to avoid. It's also super convenient for us to receive bug reports since you can post images, but it's also a direct way to give us suggestions and other comments. 

Thank you all for continuing to support us!
[i]Pugware[/i]

(Apologies for the delay in the release but technical problems with the upload of the build arose.)

notes.content:
[h1]Usurper - Early Access Weekly Update #1[/h1]

Don't forget, there are separate discussion threads on the [i]Usurper[/i] Community Hub on Steam for: [b]Suggestions[/b], [b]Bug Reports[/b], and of course the [b]FAQ[/b]. Please check these before posting in the forums!

[*] Sound cancellation issues now fixed for all enemies.
[*] Death not triggering correctly on all enemies, now fixed.
[*] 1st boss death not triggering correctly, now fixed.
[*] 2nd boss resetting after it is defeated, now fixed.
[*] 2nd boss altering state of a late game boss.
[*] 7th boss sounds and despawn fixed.
[*] 3rd boss AI changed, now cant be cheesed from across the room.
[*] Work on multiple enemies AI to add more aggression.
[*] 6th boss AI misshaps fixed.
[*] 7th boss trigger issues resolved.
[*] 1st boss door lighting changed for more obvious effect.
[*] Entire room save system overhauled.
[*] Enemy AI fix for them walking off screen.
[*] Library gate collision fixed.
[*] Evil wind animation made bearable to look at...
[*] Tutorial messages altered to reflect controller inputs too.
[*] Catacombs southwest chest is now easy to reach.
[*] Several typos fixed.
[*] No more rolling, jumping, etc in cutscenes while playing with gamepad...
[*] Save slot issues.
[*] 3rd boss inactivity resolved.
[*] 2nd boss roar effect not vanishing properly.
[*] Spear sound effect issues resolved.
[*] A certain skip can no longer be performed, nice try....

[*] 6th boss skipping AI upon changing rooms fixed.
[*] Used chest mimic spawns locations fixed.
[*] Incorrect zoom level upon loading a save fixed.
[*] Some fall through platforms appearing wider than they should be. Fixed.
[*] Some enemies walking too far to the end of platforms fixed in many places(where found).
[*] Servant incorrectly hinting on next destination, now fixed.
[*] Typo in the ending, ups...
[*] Crash caused by exiting the rebinding menu.
[*] Getting stuck in corners via wall jump should be fixed,
[*] A chest spawning sunk in the ground.
[*] Spikes remaining active after acquiring the appropriate relic.
[*] Various traps not displaying properly after acquiring the appropriate relic.
[*] Possible solution to the sound bug related to the elevator.
[*] Incorrect room name displayed upon loading the game should now be fixed.  [/list]


[h1]Added[/h1]

[list]
[*] Steam Screenshots, fully functional.
[*] Full gamepad support.
[*] Bosses viate drops.
[*] Actual blocking to prevent the progress of players unless they posses a certain relic.
[*] Mouse cursor wont show up until needed, cursor changed for temp icon.
[*] Ice cubes added, proper signaling added.
[*] Fog cubes added, proper signaling added.
[*] Borg "elevator" and shortcut added.
[*] Started developing a real tutorial area(optional), as well as a proper help menu/manual for the pause menu with detailed explanations.
[*] Full gamepad remapping.
[*] Sprites for both Sony and Microsoft controller inputs for easy readability.
[*] Analog, or D-pad movement, with weapon cross moving to opposite function.
[*] All menus now accept Analog and Dpad inputs simultaneously. (Might have missed a few things so please report if found)
[*] Spear sounds.
[*] Vitae tube system, currently only one placed however the full support for 10 is completely integrated.
[*] Navigator statues with appropriate states based on story progression.
[*] CLANG...
[*] Notification to player to not map multiple functions to the same game-pad buttons as well as information on reserved ones.
[*] First pet added, for now press F11 to get the pet and use the Elder servant at any savepoint to summon your pet. Use the pet command to switch between passive and aggressive behavior for the pet.
[*] Stat respec added. Go to the Pastor Celene in the core room, and for the Vitae price of your next level and a single Yth stone you can re-roll your stats, with the exception of Eldritch.
[*] Map base implementation added, along with tier 1 map. This will be further upgraded in future updated with the added ability to eventually draw on the map.
[*] Placed 70 Vitae tubes around the world.
[*] Eldritch now scales ALL damage received by player...
[*] 5 Whips added and can be found, used, and saved. [/list]

notes.title: Usurper going into Early Access on Friday, 8pm GMT!
notes.content:
Hello folks!

Firstly, I know it's lengthy, but please read this disclaimer about Early Access before continuing, or buying [i]Usurper[/i] in its current state:

[h1]DISCLAIMER[/h1]

Since this is an Early Access game, we remind you that whilst the entire story is complete, there are a lot of features missing or imcomplete. Therefore, if you wish to play the full feature-complete game first time, we suggest you wait until Usurper comes out of Early Access.

We will [b]NOT[/b] be increasing the price of the game once it comes out of Early Access, so you don't need to worry about the cost when deciding when to buy the game. We'd much rather you bought the version of the game [b]you[/b] will be happiest with. During [i]Usurper's[/i] time in Early Access, we expect there to be a host of balancing issues, particularly due to different stat builds. So if you want a more complete experience, please wait until the full game is released - we genuinely don't mind!

A final thing we'd like to point out is that we [b]DO[/b] have a solid and specific plan of what we will be implementing when during Early Access, as well as a history of finishing a game in Early Access.

For a brief synopsis of features to come, please do read the updated EA statement on our [i]Usurper[/i] Steam store page. If you'd like even more info, the easiest way to contact us is via our Discord server (find the link at the bottom of this post).

[h1]ABOUT EARLY ACCESS[/h1]

You could be forgiven for thinking the silence this past couple of months meant that we've not been busy... that could not be further from the truth; we've actually been working extremely hard to try and get Usurper to a state where it can enter Early Access. We know we've had to delay it a couple times, so thank you all for your patience, but we wanted to make sure we were happy with it before releasing the first paid public version.

We really hope you will enjoy the Early Access version of Usurper, and continue to support us as we add more and more content to it over the next 8-12 weeks. If you decide to buy [i]Usurper[/i] during Early Access, we would be really grateful if you could send us any bug reports/suggestions/comments. The whole point of [i]Usurper[/i] going through Early Access is to use customer feedback to make the game better, fix balancing issues, and grow the game according to what you would all like to see (where feasible of course).

[h1]UPDATES DURING EARLY ACCESS[/h1]

+ Game updates are to be expected [b]every other day.[/b]
+ Bugfixes will occur [b]at any given point[/b] during the week, depending on when bugs are found and how easy they are to fix.
+ There will be a [b]weekly[/b] update report in the form of a Steam announcement (with a set format to get changes and patch notes across quickly)
+ Our Discord server (link below) will be the easiest and most convenient place to contact us

[h1]DISCORD[/h1]

[url=https://discord.gg/REKcMkf]Join our Discord server![/url]

As always, we strongly recommend that you join our Discord server if you want to be completely up-to-date, or just want to hang out. We are extremely active on there, posting updates and screenshots most days. And if you're worried about spoilers, we have dedicated rooms for those, so they're easy to avoid. It's also super convenient for us to receive bug reports since you can post images, but it's also a direct way to give us suggestions and other comments. 

[h1]FINALLY...[/h1]

A big [b]thank you[/b] to everyone that has patiently waited for this day, we could not do it without you. We hope to see your feedback either in the relevant Steam thread, or in Discord!

[h1]Usurper Early Access Release Date: Friday 3rd November, 8pm GMT [/h1]

notes.title: Fan Art Competition - The Results!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

It's the moment you've been waiting for - the results of the fan art competition are in!

Just before we announce the winners, a [b]HUGE[/b] thank you to everyone that entered the competition. We hope you all enjoyed taking part, and we both genuinely found it incredibly difficult choosing the winners - despite there being only 6 entries. There was a very high standard of entries, not only in terms of art ability, but also in terms of imagination and creativity. Put it this way - we sat down for 45 minutes to debate who the winners would be - it was not an easy task!

[h1] And so the winners are...[/h1]

Without further ado, here are the winners, with links to their art, and our reasoning behind the decisions further below:

[b]1st place: VulpusAlbus[/b] - [i]SiS Cartoon[/i]
[b]2nd place: BenWolfers[/b] - [i]Shrouded in Beach[/i]
[b]3rd place: Toanterror[/b] - [i]Shrouded in Sanity[/i]

[h1]1st place - VulpusAlbus - Shrouded in Sanity Cartoon[/h1]

[url=https://www.slickpic.com/users/Vusfnuv/albums/Shrouded-In-Sanity/photos/14166791/shrouded-in-sanity-cartoony/]Click to view[/url]

We absolutely loved the creativity in this one! It was a very different kind of submission to the others, which made it stand out - perhaps in a way we were not expecting, which made it all the more appealing. The plasticene style won us over, and made us smile in delight! You can tell [i]Vulpus[/i] put in a lot of effort and played to their strengths, resulting in a really unique and creative bit of work. Well done!

[h1]2nd place - BenWolfers - Shrouded in Beach[/h1]

[url=http://imgur.com/5qLuam9]Click to view[/url]

A really fun take on [i]SiS[/i] - what's not to love?! Saragat, wide-eyed in swimwear, whilst in the background what we can only presume to be one-half of the "love couple" from the manor is being chased by a maid. Fantastic! It also has more neat references - the revolver, and the pocketwatch to name just two. All in all, a lot of fun - and it made us smile a heck of a lot! Well done!

[h1]3rd place - Toanterror - Shrouded in Sanity[/h1]

[url=https://68.media.tumblr.com/32e326ceb66ebfde577bc3e61a99e509/tumblr_ovobcn1sGX1st8t8oo1_1280.png] Click to view[/url]

What can we say? Beautiful. Yeah. That about sums this one up! Seriously gorgeous artwork. It conjures up the story well; blood on the blade, the death screen via the pocketwatch, and then there's the whole beckoning glyph. The attention to detail, and sheer time it must've taken to create this makes this a really solid 3rd place. A really lovely bit of art that is worthy of being cover art. Once again, beautiful! Well done!

[h1]To All Entrants[/h1]

Once again, huge congratulations to the winners, but also a really hearty pat on the back to all those that entered. You [i]all[/i] showed a lot of effort and made us both smile with joy at your fan art. We hope you all enjoyed taking part, and really hope none of you leave feeling disheartened. Please feel free to upload your fan art onto the artwork section of [i]Shrouded in Sanity[/i] on Steam!

[h1]IMPORTANT[/h1]

[i]To all entrants, Steve or Jam will be sending your prizes via PM either on Steam or Discord, so please make sure you have enabled communication/direct messaging if you haven't already. We will also take your details of the gravestone or pet reward this way.[/i]

Prizes will be distributed either later today or whenever we get a private venue to exchange them.

Don't forget, everyone that took part gets a key to the SiS OST, whether you won or not!

[h1]Closing words[/h1]

[url=https://www.slickpic.com/users/Vusfnuv/albums/Shrouded-In-Sanity/photos/14166791/shrouded-in-sanity-cartoony/]Click to view[/url]

notes.title: It's Competition Time! (w/ prizes of course)
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]
Alright, time for a bit of fun! As a token of our appreciation to our awesome fanbase (that's you guys and gals), we want to give you all a fun little competition (with prizes - we'll get to that in a bit) to get your teeth stuck into.

As developers, we love it when people enjoy the game so much that they make fan art. It absolutely thrills us when people spend their own spare time drawing what they love (and maybe even what they hated!) about our games. And so we figured [i]"Well, instead of getting people to 'like and share a post' in order to enter a competition... let's get them to be creative and show us their fan art!".[/i] To make things even more creative, should you win first prize, your very own design (subject of which is mentioned later) will make it into the game itself!

[b]About the competiton:[/b]

1) This will not just be judged on a "who can draw the best?" basis. We want to open this up to as many people as possible, regardless of artistic ability. We don't want people to feel left out, or feel they couldn't possibly enter... so whilst artistic talent will account for a small %age of the points, we'll also be picking the top three entries under terms such as "creativity, interpretation, uniqueness" etc. 

3) You can post your artwork anywhere that's convenient for you (i.e. Our Discord, Twitter, on our Steam forums, Imgur, FlickR, your own website etc.). The only proviso for entering is that you send us a link to it in the comments [b]on this announcement[/b]. If you'd rather send us a DM through Steam, you can do.

4) The fanart can be of either [i]Shrouded in Sanity[/i] or [i]Usurper[/i]. You could even do something Lovecraftian, although we'd prefer it if it related to either game since that's more fitting.

5) The submission date for this will be [b]Sunday the 3rd of September at 10pm GMT/UTC+1[/b] (Sorry about the +1, British Summer Time and all that) So that means you have just a little shy of 2 weeks. We know it's not a long deadline, but we can't leave it too much later.

[h1]The prizes:[/h1]

It wouldn't be a competition without prizes...

[b]1st place:[/b]
- Your very own pet design to be implemented into [i]Usurper[/i]
- 3x Steam keys of [i]Usurper[/i] for you and 2 friends
- 3x Steam keys for [i]Shrouded in Sanity[/i] OST DLC

[b]2nd place:[/b]
- Special gravestone in-game for one person (that sounded more morbid than we realised initially)
- 2x Steam keys for [i]Usurper[/i]
- 2x Steam keys for [i]Shrouded in Sanity[/i] OST DLC

[b]3rd place:[/b]
- 1x Steam key for [i]Usurper[/i]
- 1x Steam key for [i]Shrouded in Sanity[/i] OST DLC

[b]Everyone that entered[/b] (that's right, everyone!):
- 1x Steam key for [i]Shrouded in Sanity[/i] OST DLC [i](We will only give one key per person, regardless of the number of submissions by that person)[/i]

[h1]Important Notes:[/h1]

- All prizes will be given out as soon as such items are available (so after Early Access, and once the game and DLC has been fully released). Since the game and DLC has not yet been released, Steam handles keys as if they are pre-purchases.

- For the pet reward, we will not use a design lifted from anything that already exists, or anything that bears a significant enough resemblance. We also won't be using things that could be deemed offensive, sexually suggestive (within reason, I mean Lovecraft and all that can be slightly suggestive at times)

- If you have an idea for the pet, but don't know how to draw it, Steve is happy to take on the challenge. He will obviously have to copy and ammend any drawing himself anyway, so this is no extra bother.

- For the gravestone reward, we will not accept profanities or content of an offensive nature. We reserve the right to use a little discretion and may ask you to revise if necessary. 

- We will allow multiple submissions per person, but you can only win one place (i.e. you can't come 1st and 2nd, 2nd and 3rd, or 1st and 3rd). That would be unfair.

- We will not allow a group submission (we can't split the prizes between mutliple people, but you can of course share any prizes you win with others).

[h1] Finally... [/h1]

So that about sums it up. Go forth and think about what you could draw, and like we said - don't worry too much about your artistic talents. All we ask for is a decent amount of effort and thought. 

[b]Don't forget[/b] about our official [url=https://discord.gg/REKcMkf]Pugware Discord Server[/url], where you can conveniently find out anything you've ever wanted to know about [i]SiS[/i] or [i]Usurper[/i] - There are dedicated rooms for updates, spoilers, general chat and more. Both Steve and Jam are usually around between 10am - 10pm GMT/UTC+1 every day.

We can't wait to see your fan art, and the very best of luck!

[i]Pugware[/i]
